segments.title: A lost meerkat found its WAY HOME
segments.say: A meerkat got lost in the desert, all alone. It still found its way home.

segments.title: Moved far from home
segments.say: Scientists moved meerkats about one and a half kilometers from home, one at a time.

segments.title: 18 of 20 made it
segments.say: Eighteen out of twenty made it back.

segments.title: 13 rejoined on their own
segments.say: Thirteen found their group again, all on their own.

segments.title: Group animals, SOLO skills
segments.sub: They live in groups but **steer alone**
segments.say: They live in groups, but each one can steer solo.

segments.title: Source: J Exp Biol
segments.say: The study is in the Journal of Experimental Biology.
Follow for Weird Animal number 27 tonight.
